definition: The title representation of the work supplied by a source.
source_precedents: Observed in CT/TTT; public precedents include title.

definition: A person or performer representation associated with a performance.
source_precedents: Source-specific interpretation may distinguish singer/performer roles.

definition: A person credited as composer for a composition.
source_precedents: TTT provides composer information; CT also provides composer metadata.

definition: A person credited as conductor for a performance.
source_precedents: Present in common/TTT vocabulary; may be absent in a source.

definition: Date associated with the recording, preserving source precision.
source_precedents: CT and TTT both supply recording-date evidence.

definition: A source-issued release or release representation; not automatically canonical identity.
source_precedents: CT monthly releases and TTT album/release representations.

definition: Position of a performance within a release.
Source genre/category interpreted into MusicStewardship vocabulary.
source_precedents: CT/TTT source genre vocabularies may require lookup.

definition: The source medium/media representation.
A record/catalog component interpreted as a record identifier.
A matrix identifier supplied or decoded from source evidence.
source_precedents: CT and TTT historical/public reference precedents.

definition: A take identifier supplied or decoded from source evidence.
source_precedents: TTT Take component; CT identifier suffix can contain take.

definition: Identity of the source system or collection providing the record.
Source-relative file representation/path.
Directory hierarchy supplied by the source tree.
Original filename representation, preserved exactly.
Source catalog-number representation before interpretation.
source_precedents: Distinct from source-specific identifiers and matrix identifiers.

definition: A compound source identifier before decomposition.
A source-provenance/staging track-like value.
Source identifier side component such as A/B.
Source-specific take component as represented by a source identifier.
source_precedents: Observed in CT; distinct from take_identifier until semantics are settled.

definition: Crackling Tunes source identifier representation, e.g. CT...-A1.
source_precedents: CT-specific term; filename and embedded CATALOG # corroborate in tested release.

definition: Recording-date evidence extracted specifically from a filename.
source_precedents: Preserves filename precision separately from embedded date.

definition: Reference identifier linking an observation to an external provider.
source_precedents: Used for TANGO-DJ.AT, Discogs, future providers.

definition: Evidence that independent identifier representations agree.
source_precedents: CT 21.08 test showed filename and CATALOG # agreement.

definition: The complete source artist field before role decomposition.
Source album-artist representation.
source_precedents: Preserve source value; may support ensemble evidence.

definition: Derived indication that a performance has lyrics.
Derived indication that a performance is instrumental.
Pitch/frequency supplemental data.
Key associated with the recording.
Key associated with the composition/score.
Technical properties of an audio asset.
Original source comment text preserved before interpretation.
source_precedents: Supports later clause extraction without replacing source text.

definition: Source-provided encoding/provenance text associated with the audio asset.
notes: The TTT example contains both publisher/date-style text and a description of the 78-rpm shellac collection. Preserve as source evidence until its semantic decomposition is defined.

definition: Source-provided image/artwork reference associated with an audio item.
notes: The TTT example points to a Pochette/cover image file. Preserve as source evidence; artwork identity/role can be modeled later.
